sentences.en: Brown is not so much a writer as a scholar.
sentences.zh: 布朗更多的是学者而非作家。

sentences.en: The boy talks as if he were a great scholar.
sentences.zh: 那男孩说话好像自己是大名鼎鼎的学者。

sentences.en: The scholar spent what little money he had on books.
sentences.zh: 这位学者把所剩无几的钱都花在了书上。

senses.zh: 奖学金获得者,学者,聪颖勤奋的学生,〈俚〉有文化的人，有某种文科知识的人
